gizmo.description: Barattoonni hima, keeyyata ykn fakkii barreeffama keessaa ragaa mallattoo hundaa ta'an alaabaan mallatteessu, ykn kutaa gaaffii akka gaariitti deebisu filatu.

configure.description: Ragaa mallatteessi: barattoonni alaabaa hunda cinaa ragaa isaa maxxansu. Tokko filadhu: barattoonni kutaa tokkicha gaaffii akka gaariitti deebisu filatu.

configure.title: Barattoonni filatu

configure.description: Mallattoolee barattoonni kaa'an. Iddoo tokkoon tokkoon isaanii itti argamu filachuuf baafata cufaa keessatti Deebii mallatteessi fayyadami.

configure.title: Barreeffama dubbisaa
configure.description: Barreeffama barattoonni keessatti hojjetan. HTML kamiyyuu: mataduree, keeyyata, tarree fi fakkiiwwan.

advanced.title: Yaalii
advanced.description: Barataan yeroo meeqa mirkaneessuu danda'a. 0 jechuun daangaa malee jechuudha.

advanced.title: Maramee jalqabi
advanced.description: Yeroo maramuu danda'u, akka sarara cufamee gaaffii fi haala isaa qofa agarsiisu jalqabi.
